Timothy's schedule has multiple blocked times, making Tuesday infeasible due to no available one-hour slots. On Monday, a slot exists from 14:00 to 15:00, but it is avoided due to Judith's preference. On Wednesday, a slot before 12:00 (e.g., 9:30-10:30) is available but conflicts with Judith's preference. The optimal slot that respects all schedules and preferences is on Wednesday from 12:00 to 13:00. This time is within work hours, avoids Judith's blocked period (11:30-12:00), and aligns with her preference to avoid Wednesday before 12:00.
